meta.description: Aaron Ryan Shamika - software engineer with backend experience in Node.js, TypeScript, C#/.NET and SQL Server.

basics.name: Aaron Ryan Shamika
basics.title: Software Engineer (Node.js / TypeScript)
basics.summary: Software engineer with backend experience in Node.js and TypeScript, including an HR management web app serving 500+ employees, plus C#/.NET and SQL Server work supporting around 600 users. Building a TypeScript and React card-game simulator with a rules engine covering 1,254 cards. Looking for a full-stack JavaScript/TypeScript role.

highlights: Automated document uploads with an overnight SQL Server stored procedure run via Groveller, loading files into ClickHome by job number and removing the manual upload step

Supported around 600 users of ClickHome and Databuild, third-party Australian construction management applications, resolving 10-20 tickets per day, often over calls to pin down the real problem and explain the fix in plain terms
Gathered users' requirements and translated them into business logic, implemented as SQL Server stored procedures and functions that maintain the applications and automate workflows
Built Crystal Reports and SSRS reports to users' data requirements
Developed 3 custom AutoCount plug-ins in C# on the .NET Framework using the AutoCount API
Maintained and updated legacy plug-in projects
Mentored 2 interns on the AutoCount API and .NET Framework and onboarded them to the team's repository workflow
Customer-facing service roles, including at a Japanese restaurant; studied Japanese alongside
Built the backend for an HR management web app serving 500+ employees with Node.js, TypeScript and AdonisJS
Automated 20+ functional tests with Selenium IDE, replacing manual regression checks
Introduced AdonisJS built-in features in place of custom code, setting a consistent standard across the codebase

projects.name: Cardfight!! Vanguard Simulator
highlights: Building a fan-made, fully automated browser version of the card game, with a rules engine that resolves every phase, check, trigger and guard
Implemented abilities for 1,254 cards through an ability interpreter with one handler per condition, timing, cost and effect, so a new mechanic is a new entry
Added a rule-based AI opponent, a deck builder and a scraper that generates the card data, structured as an npm workspaces monorepo with a Vitest test suite

projects.name: Road Crack Detection System
highlights: Trained a DCNN on 1,000+ road images to detect cracks and potholes, reaching 70-90% accuracy
Enabled drone-based road inspections, saving civil engineers time checking roads

projects.name: Horror Soccer Game
highlights: Led a team of 4 and implemented ball physics, player interactions and basic animation systems

education.degree: Bachelor of Computer Science (Computer Graphics and Multimedia Software)
